method: Exact AST-extracted recent-open effect and owner declarations from ConversationReader, compiled with TypeScript. Installed QueryClient/Observer; explicit hook/effect, transport and account-generation doubles. Other Reader code is excluded.
controls: Valid same-revision open is recorded once and preserves full detail
No request before conversation data is available
Later reading time may carry lower progress
Accepted same-visit data refresh does not repost
Synthetic effect replay does not double-admit
Position, complete-turn and offline cache namespaces remain untouched
failure_groups: Lower canonical revision, older/equal reading time and invalid identity/revision/timestamp overwrite current state
Higher partial summary labels old detail instead of requesting complete canonical detail
Recent list is not invalidated; offline recording invalidates remote lists
Rejected open and A-B-A stale failure re-enable the non-idempotent POST
Route/unmount/account changes do not fence publication or old-view admission
Changing data source reuses the other source's id-only reservation
Rejected detached refresh promises are not handled
